content.title: Portland Trail Blazers vs Denver Nuggets injury report: Who's playing, injured and questionable players, head-to-head records, team stats, and more (March 22, 2026)
content.text: Portland Trail Blazers vs Denver Nuggets (Image via Getty)The Portland Trail Blazers head to Ball Arena to take on the Denver Nuggets on Sunday, March 22, 2026. It is a late-season Western Conference game where both teams are working through different priorities. Denver is focused on tightening its rotation before the playoffs, while Portland continues to manage injuries and evaluate its younger players.As the regular season nears its end, availability and minutes will play a major role in how both teams approach this game. Denver has most of its core available and will look to maintain rhythm.
